Overview

There is a reason Data & Lakehouse for AgriFinance & Commodity Markets pilots stall between demo and production: nobody owns the seam between the clever part and the operational estate. Our builds assign that seam a named owner from day one, wrap it in contracts and telemetry, and make the first quarter produce artifacts — not slideware. Agriculture & Food Systems punishes generic deployments. yield per hectare moves faster than batch cycles, EU deforestation rules demands evidence chains most tools cannot produce, and the estate is heterogeneous — which is why every engagement starts with the seams named above rather than a platform-first rollout.
